title: Passacaglia and Fugue in C minor
video_use_ideas: A repeating bass that grows variation by variation: slow, steady build to a climax.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 741 ('Passacaglia', for Organ); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Urs Metzger). Edition source: 8656, C. F. Peters, Leipzig. The Mutopia MIDI uses flute-type registration; re-voice to church organ (GM 19) for a heavier sound. Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
